shellCommands.command: cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -100

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/lab node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls; grep -ril "calendar" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -20

npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@^4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@^2.6.0 2>&1 | tail -5 && cat package.json | grep -A6 '"dependencies"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components 2>/dev/null || ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components && cat package.json | grep -E '"(main|module|exports|sideEffects)"' -A3 | head -30; cat dist/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts; ls dist/esm/components/Calendar; grep -rn "import.*css" dist/esm/components/Calendar/*.js | head; cat dist/esm/components/CalendarView/CalendarBase.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; ls dist/esm/components/CalendarView

cat dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/useCalendarState.d.ts | head -80; grep -n "CalendarSize\|CalendarInstance" -A4 dist/esm/components/CalendarView/CalendarView.d.ts | head -30; cat dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/types.d.ts | head -40

cat dist/esm/components/CalendarView/i18n/index.js; grep -rn "useLang\|lang" dist/esm/components/CalendarView/*.js dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/*.js | head -20; ls dist/esm/components/CalendarView/i18n
